continuation_rule: Review the externally completed 200-card checkpoint before handing off the remaining 4,800. No internal agent execution is scheduled.

gate.pause_on_failure: Retain valid partial artifacts, expand review and repair. Do not proceed through a failed checkpoint.
gate.required: All structural checks pass; author-source checks cover every card; all sampled findings and affected-source followups resolved; short-card clarity reviewed independently.

selection_inputs: Frozen public catalog inventory only; private preference ratings excluded.
source_budget_policy: Track retrieved-source derived prose across card bodies, takeaways and substantive notes; same-page/companion representations share the applicable allowance. Preserve actual page limits and access failures.
word_counting: Whitespace-separated card body; titles and sources excluded.
